title_alternatives: The 401k Mistake That Destroyed Enron Workers
Why Your 401k Has a Hidden $47,000 Risk
youtube_short.description: Most workers hold 14% of their 401k in their own company's stock — financial advisors say 5% is the max safe limit. When Enron collapsed in 2001, employees lost their jobs AND their retirement savings at the same time — $2 billion wiped out overnight. Your 401k might have the exact same hidden time bomb sitting in it right now. Log into your account today, find your company's ticker, and if it's over 5% move it to a broad index fund — it takes five minutes and could protect $47,000 of your future. #401k #personalfinance #investing #retirementplanning #moneytips
